text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  issues:
    types: [commented]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize]

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install super-linter

      - name: Run Super-Linter
        id: super-linter
        run: super-linter

      - name: Check for @claude mention
        if: github.event.comment.body contains '@claude'
        run: echo "Claude mentioned! Running Claude Code review."

      - name: Get changed files
        id: get-changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json

      - name: Run Claude Code Action
        if: github.event.comment.body contains '@claude'
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: "@claude"
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          allowed_tools: "read/write files, interact with repo"

      - name: Comment on PR with Claude results
        if: github.event.comment.body contains '@claude'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          message: "Claude has reviewed your code. Please see the results above."
```
